verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that ships AI agents, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy or a no-training commitment. The export, audit and monitoring controls are adjacent features and do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
